name: TMPLinkHandler
src_typeComment: Drop on a TMP_Text (UI or 3D world-space) that contains rich-text links, e.g. "Read our <link=\"terms\">Terms</link>". Detects clicks/taps on link-tagged text and fires OnLinkClicked with the link's ID string. For 3D world-space TextMeshPro (no parent Canvas), the camera rendering the scene needs a Physics Raycaster component for OnPointerClick to fire at all.

src_members.sig: public UnityEvent<string> OnLinkClicked = new UnityEvent<string>(); // the link ID from <link="id">...</link>
src_members.name: UnityEvent
